title: Isikhalazo Esiviwayo Ngaphezu Kwengxolo
intro: Uva ilizwi liphuma kuluntu apho ingcinezelo iye yaba yinto eqhelekileyo. Akukho kubonakaliswa kwamandla okuphendula isikhalazo; endaweni yoko, isibheno esithe ngqo sifikelela kuAllah, kwaye impendulo ifika entliziyweni yonqulo ngokwalo. Ngubani owenze eso sikhalazo, nguwuphi umbuzo owalandelayo, kwaye yeyiphi inyaniso eyaqinisekiswayo?
clues: Ndavakalisa eso sikhalazo ngqo ku-Allah kwisikhalazo sam.
U-Allah wasiva isikhalazo waza waphendula ngomngeni malunga nenkolelo yam.
Impendulo yayibuza ukuba ndingasilela njani ukukholelwa ku-Allah, oMnye noPhakamileyo.
Ndabuza ke ukuba kutheni uAllah emele abathande abantu abangakholwayo.
Ndingu-Uzair, oqanjwe kwiSurah Az-Zukhruf njengomntu owasiva isikhalazo sakhe uAllah.

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
